name: Bstrlib (The Better String Library)
listed_description: Length-tracked string structure (bstring) and function set meant to replace NUL-terminated C string handling, with split, find/replace, string lists and bstreams; C core with optional C++ wrapper.
claim_text: Book makes no speed claim; it calls bstrings a significant improvement over NUL-terminated buffers. The project README (not the book) claims improved string-operation performance and a C++ wrapper faster than std::string.
guessed_baseline: C standard library string.h functions (strcpy/strcat/strlen); std::string for the C++ wrapper
found_in: book: Learn C Programming, 2nd ed. (2024), Appendix, section The Better String Library (Bstrlib)
